1.w: By the rivers of Babylon we sit down and weep when we remember Zion.

2.w: On the poplars in her midst we hang our harps,

3.w: for there our captors ask us to compose songs; those who mock us demand that we be happy, saying: “Sing for us a song about Zion!”

4.w: How can we sing a song to the Lord in a foreign land?

5.w: If I forget you, O Jerusalem, may my right hand be crippled.

6.w: May my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth, if I do not remember you, and do not give Jerusalem priority over whatever gives me the most joy.

7.w: Remember, O Lord , what the Edomites did on the day Jerusalem fell. They said, “Tear it down, tear it down, right to its very foundation!”

8.w: O daughter Babylon, soon to be devastated, how blessed will be the one who repays you for what you dished out to us.

9.w: How blessed will be the one who grabs your babies and smashes them on a rock.
